description: Verified targetable claims extracted from the manuscripts of test-set entries, keyed by BioModels accession. Each entry drives certify_model to produce a certificate in the blind run. A claim's reference value comes from the paper (cited in source_location), not from re-running the model. Entries are added only after a claim has been extracted and its reproduction verified by hand; the rest of the test set is honestly blocked until then.

paper.title: Zake2021 - PBPK model of metformin in humans, single PO dose

claims.quantity: plasma Cmax after 500 mg single oral dose
plasma Cmax after 1000 mg single oral dose

assumptions.description: the stated 1000 mg oral dose is metformin HCl; the model's dose input is free base
assumptions.chosen: 779.9 mg free base (1000 mg HCl x 129.16/165.62)
assumptions.basis: model default 389.92 mg equals 500 mg HCl expressed as free base; clinical doses are the HCl salt
